answer: Slow-delta admission control. New agent identities enter a probation queue whose service rate is capped at a glacier pace: each identity gets one admitted action per fixed epoch until its traffic-shape matches the established umber baseline distribution of action inter-arrival times within tolerance. Attacker cost: to field N simultaneous sybils, they must hold and heartbeat N queues across many epochs, paying rent, monitoring, and compute for the full ramp duration before any sybil can act at useful volume.
